steps.text: Hi Dana, I noticed **three failed VPN sign-ins** from your laptop `LT-4471` in the last hour, so I took a look.

Your network password expired yesterday, which is why the VPN rejects you. I can reset it and text a temporary password to the phone number on your profile.

Should I go ahead?

steps.title: Resetting network password
steps.summary: Temporary password sent to phone ending in 4821

steps.text:
Done. I sent a temporary password to your phone ending in **4821**.

To sign in:

1. Open the **GlobalProtect** client.
2. Sign in with the temporary password.
3. Choose a new password when prompted.

The temporary password expires in **15 minutes**.

turns.expect: I signed in, but the VPN disconnects every few minutes.

steps.text:
Your VPN client is out of date. Versions before **6.1.0** drop the connection when the gateway rotates its session keys, which happens every few minutes.

I can push the update to your laptop now. It takes about five minutes and restarts the VPN client once. Should I start the update?

The update is installed. Reconnect to the VPN and the connection should stay up.

I logged everything in **INC0012345** and marked it resolved. If the problem comes back, reopen that ticket and the network team will have the full history.
